sentences.text:
Author: Alok Kumar Verma
Bench: Alok Kumar Verma
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders
Sl. or proceedings
 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order
S No or directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  17.01.2024 ABA No. 72 of 2024  Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

Present Application has been filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of Anticipatory Bail under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 in connection with the First Information Report No. 56 of 2022 (Criminal Case No. 3 of 2023), registered at police station Mallital, District Nainital.
2. Mr. Shashi Kant Shandilya, learned counsel with Mr. Ajay Bahuguna, learned counsel for the applicant and Mr. Bhaskar Joshi, learned A.G.A. for the State.

3. Mr. Shashi Kant Shandilya, Advocate, has requested to permit the applicant to withdraw the present Anticipatory Bail Application with liberty to file a fresh Anticipatory Bail Application with better particulars.
4. The said submission has not been opposed by the State.
5. Present Anticipatory Bail Application (No. 72 of 2024) is dismissed as withdrawn by granting liberty to file a fresh Anticipatory Bail Application, in accordance with law.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) Vacation Judge 17.01.2024 Shiksha ABA/72/2024 on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70860427/
